mapper.insert: INSERT INTO result (registration_id, event_id, item_id, user_id, score_value, score_rank, is_published, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{registrationId}, #{eventId}, #{itemId}, #{userId}, #{scoreValue}, #{scoreRank}, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score_value = VALUES(score_value), score_rank = VALUES(score_rank), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.event_id as eventId, s.item_id as itemId, s.registration_id as registrationId, e.name as eventName, p.name as itemName, u.name as athleteName, g.name as grade, s.score_value as scoreValue, s.score_rank as scoreRank, s.is_published as isPublished, s.create_time as createTime FROM result s LEFT JOIN event e ON s.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN event_item p ON s.item_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN grade g ON u.grade_id = g.id WHERE s.event_id = #{eventId} AND s.is_published = 1 ORDER BY p.id ASC, s.score_rank ASC
